Measurement gap found while validating, outside this quest's scope: scripts/check-fast-static.js resolves its base from LAGRANGE_CHECK_BASE and otherwise diffs against HEAD, so a change that is already committed locally is invisible to every changed-path checker it runs. On this tree 'npm run check' reported ok with 'changed paths: 1522 (0 JavaScript)' and neither linted nor scoped-ratcheted the new script; with LAGRANGE_CHECK_BASE set to the pre-patch commit the same command reported FAIL eslint(1 changed). A green 'npm run check' after a local commit is therefore not evidence that the committed change passed the changed-path layer. Owner: publish-gate-hygiene.
